name: Crazy Traffic VR
summary:
Full throttle. No brakes.

Climb into the driver's seat of a speeding ambulance and take on an endless three-lane highway packed with traffic. Crazy Traffic VR puts you inside the cabin: reach out, grab the steering wheel with one or both hands and swerve between cars at full speed.

DRIVE YOUR WAY • Grab a real 3D steering wheel with your hands, or steer with the left thumbstick. Both work at any time. • Hold the right trigger to fire the nitro and feel the speed. • Arcade steering for maximum comfort, or
